route.name: Hvar
route.sub: 3 nights · Amfora Hvar Grand Beach Resort

blocks.title: Arrive MIA, check bags
blocks.detail: Arrive 3+ hrs before departure for a 2-week international trip with a family of 4.

blocks.title: United - MIA -> EWR - Nonstop - 2h45m
blocks.detail: Domestic connection to Newark, United's hub for the transatlantic leg.
blocks.notes: Representative flight/time - exact 2027 schedule not yet published.

blocks.title: Layover at EWR
blocks.detail: Long layover built in deliberately - real buffer against the MIA-EWR leg running late and missing the one daily nonstop to Dubrovnik.
blocks.notes: Lunch/dinner in the terminal, budget ~$60 for the family.

blocks.title: United UA - EWR -> DBV - Nonstop - ~9h
blocks.detail: United's seasonal summer nonstop Newark-Dubrovnik route. Overnight flight, lands 9:00 AM local time Sunday, July 18 (6-hour time change).
blocks.notes: Live seats.aero data for nearby May/June 2027 dates showed United EWR-DBV nonstop at ~40,000 miles/person in economy. Exact July 17 2027 space isn't loaded yet - United's booking window opens roughly 330-336 days out, which lands around late August 2026 for this date. Budgeting ~45,000 miles/person (180,000 total) to cover the MIA-EWR domestic connection plus the international leg - set a seats.aero alert for EWR-DBV in August 2026.
blocks.flag: Not yet bookable - exact fare/schedule confirms once United releases July 2027 space (~Aug 2026). This nonstop route only runs seasonally in summer - reconfirm it's still operating for 2027 before relying on it.

blocks.title: Land at DBV - immigration, bags, customs
Transfer to hotel
blocks.detail: Dubrovnik Airport -> Mlini/Srebreno, ~11-20 min depending on traffic.

blocks.title: Sheraton Dubrovnik Riviera Hotel - check in
blocks.detail: 2 Rooms (Classic Suites).
blocks.notes: Marriott retired fixed award charts in 2022-23 - Bonvoy is now fully dynamic. Recent tracked point costs for this property run ~25,000-30,000 pts/night/room in peak season - budgeting the midpoint (~27,000) x 2 rooms x 5 nights = 270,000 points. Booking 2 rooms because every room/suite category here caps at 3 guests even with a rollaway (~€75/night extra) added - it's genuinely unclear from public listings whether a Classic Suite + rollaway can legally hold 2 adults + 2 kids.
blocks.roomType: 2 Classic Suites (48 sqm each) - confirm bed config
blocks.flag: Call the hotel or Marriott Reservations directly to confirm whether 1 suite + rollaway can hold 2A+2K instead of 2 rooms - would roughly halve the points cost if allowed. Also: this property has had August points blackouts in past years (phone-only booking) - check availability early.

blocks.title: Rest / pool time at the hotel
blocks.detail: Deliberately no anchor activity today given the overnight flight - jet lag buffer.

blocks.title: Dinner - Konoba Marinero, Mlini
blocks.detail: Whole grilled fish, prawns, squid-ink risotto - easy, close first night. Mains from €19.

days.title: Old Town, City Walls & Cable Car

blocks.title: Drive/taxi to Dubrovnik Old Town (Pile Gate)
Dubrovnik City Walls walk
blocks.detail: Full loop of the walls, first entry to beat heat/crowds. Ticket includes Lovrijenac Fortress + Western Outer Walls.
blocks.notes: €35-40/adult, €15/child (under 18), under-7 free. ~€110/$120 for the family. wallsofdubrovnik.com

blocks.title: Old Town wander - Stradun, Onofrio's Fountain
Lunch - Marco Polo Restaurant
blocks.detail: Courtyard on Lučarica, near the walls. Fuži with shrimp/truffle, Neretva blue crab.

blocks.title: Cable car up Srđ
blocks.detail: ~4 min ride each way, panoramic view over Old Town and the coast. Runs until midnight in summer.
blocks.notes: €27-30/adult return, €10-18/child return - budgeting ~€95/$103 for the family, confirm exact 2027 pricing. dubrovnikcablecar.com

blocks.title: Rest / pool time at the hotel
blocks.detail: Real buffer after a big morning on foot in July heat.

blocks.title: Dinner - Konoba Forno, Mlini
blocks.detail: Family-run, sea-view terrace, generous portions, real kids' menu.

blocks.title: Sea kayak tour to Lokrum Island
blocks.detail: Dubrovnik Sea Kayaking (DSK) - one of the few operators officially authorized in Old Town waters. Paddle out to Lokrum, swim/snorkel stop, paddle back.
blocks.notes: €32-45/person for a 2-3hr tour -> ~€150-180/$160 for the family. Minimum paddling age is typically 7-8; a younger child can ride free between parents in a double kayak without paddling. dubrovnikseakayaking.com
blocks.flag: Confirm exact age policy with the operator given the kids' ages at travel time.

blocks.title: Change / rinse off
blocks.detail: Dedicated changeover block after a morning in the water.

blocks.title: Lunch - Lokanda Peskarija, Old Harbor
blocks.detail: Casual, right on the Old Harbor. Fried calamari, black cuttlefish risotto. No reservations - typical wait, worth it.

blocks.title: Dinner - Lorenco Dine and Wine, Srebreno
blocks.detail: Fresh tuna/swordfish, grilled vegetables - wine-forward but casual.

blocks.title: Full-day sailing - Koločep, Lopud, Šipan
blocks.detail: Elaphiti Islands day sail - swim/snorkel stops at each island, lunch on board (fish/meat/veg choice).
blocks.notes: Shared-boat group tours run roughly $80-120/person -> ~$400-480 for the family; private charter runs ~€400 for up to 3 people (would need to confirm pricing for 4). Get a live quote once dates are locked, pricing varies a lot by operator.
blocks.flag: Lunch is included in the tour price - no separate meal block needed today.

blocks.title: Change / rinse off
blocks.detail: Dedicated changeover block after a full day on and in the water.

blocks.title: Dinner - Konoba King, Plat
blocks.detail: Grilled seafood platter, peka-style lamb. Book ~2 days ahead.

blocks.title: Hotel beach & pool - free morning
blocks.detail: No anchor activity - real rest day.

blocks.title: Lunch - Restaurant Srebreno
blocks.detail: Directly across from the hotel - easy, no transit needed.
blocks.flag: No verifiable official site found - confirm current operating status by phone before relying on it.

blocks.title: Old Town evening stroll - shops, gelato
Dinner - Restaurant Dubrovnik
blocks.detail: Inside an old fort, Michelin-recognized, sunset terrace. The one special/dressier night of the Dubrovnik stay - reserve ~a week ahead in July.

blocks.title: Sheraton Dubrovnik Riviera Hotel - check out
Last morning at the hotel / lunch
blocks.detail: Light morning before the ferry - pool time, then an early lunch near the hotel.

blocks.title: Drive/taxi to Gruž ferry port, Dubrovnik
Krilo catamaran - Dubrovnik (Gruž) -> Hvar
blocks.detail: ~3h20m. Foot-passenger only, daily Apr 1-Oct 31. Book well ahead - this line sells out in July/August.
blocks.notes: ~€50/adult one-way x4 travelers = ~€200/$217 - noted the est reflects the family total. Exact 2027 sailing times not yet published; 2026 pattern used as the best current proxy.
blocks.flag: This is the single daily through-sailing to Split via Hvar - if it sells out, TP Line runs a similar Dubrovnik-Korčula-Hvar-Split service as a backup.

blocks.title: Walk to hotel from the Hvar ferry landing
Amfora Hvar Grand Beach Resort - check in
blocks.detail: Family Room (partitioned bedroom + sofa bed, sleeps 4 in one room).
blocks.notes: No Marriott/Hyatt/Hilton presence on Hvar itself - this is a real cash-rate resort booking. Shoulder-season rates start ~$140/night; budgeting an estimated $400/night x 3 nights = $1,200 for July peak, unconfirmed - get a live quote closer to booking.
blocks.flag: Price is an estimate, not a quote. Beachfront resort with cascading pool + waterslides, kids club, ~10 min walk to Old Town/harbor - the closer match to this family's usual resort-with-grounds preference vs. a cramped boutique hotel.

blocks.title: Dinner - Dalmatino, Hvar Town
blocks.detail: Steak & fish house, pašticada, lamb under the bell - easy first night.

blocks.title: Walk to the water taxi dock
blocks.detail: Near the Mlinar bakery on the Riva.

blocks.title: Water taxi to Palmižana (Sveti Klement)
blocks.detail: Runs every 20-30 min in summer. Drops you at a good family beach bay for the day - no island-to-island hopping on the taxi, just one destination.

blocks.title: Beach morning at Palmižana
blocks.detail: Calm, clear water, good for the kids.

blocks.title: Lunch at Palmižana
blocks.detail: Casual beachfront taverna on the bay - order fresh, no need to leave the beach.

blocks.title: Water taxi back to Hvar Town
Change / rinse off at the hotel
Dinner - Konoba Menego
blocks.detail: Stone-walled tavern in Groda, octopus salad, gnocchi with shrimp. Cash only.

blocks.title: Fortica (Spanjola) Fortress
blocks.detail: Short uphill walk from town, panoramic views over the harbor and Pakleni Islands - light, low-fatigue morning stop.

blocks.title: Wander Hvar Town - main square, harbor
Lunch - Passarola
blocks.detail: Rooftop terrace, handmade pasta, lobster with black macaroni.

blocks.title: Beach club - hotel beach
blocks.detail: Free afternoon, pack for Split.

blocks.title: Dinner - Giaxa
blocks.detail: 15th-century Gothic courtyard, tuna tartare, braised beef cheeks - the special night of the Hvar stay.

blocks.title: Amfora Hvar Grand Beach Resort - check out
Last morning in Hvar Town
blocks.detail: Free time, last beach/harbor walk before the ferry.

blocks.title: Jadrolinija catamaran - Hvar -> Split
blocks.detail: Direct Split-Hvar line (more frequent than the single daily Dubrovnik-Split through-service). ~1h15m, representative midday departure - exact 2027 schedule not yet published.
blocks.notes: ~€25/adult one-way x4 -> ~€100-120/$110-130 for the family; est includes some buffer for fare variation.

blocks.title: Transfer to hotel
blocks.detail: Split ferry terminal -> Podstrana, ~26-29 km, roughly 27-40 min depending on summer traffic.

blocks.title: Le Méridien Lav, Split - check in
blocks.detail: Family Suite (45 sqm, two connecting bedrooms, two bathrooms, separate living room - genuinely sleeps 4 in one unit).
blocks.notes: Historically tracked as Category 6 (~85,000-point certificate tier under Marriott's old fixed chart); Bonvoy is now fully dynamic, so no fixed number exists. Budgeting ~60,000 points/night x 4 nights = 240,000 points as a reasonable estimate for a Family Suite in July peak - unconfirmed. Cash alternative if points aren't available: estimate ~$500-600/night.
blocks.flag: Suites are frequently cash-only or points+cash rather than a straight points redemption at Marriott properties - confirm the Family Suite is actually bookable on points before counting on it.

blocks.title: Rest / pool time at the hotel
Dinner - Conlemani
blocks.detail: Right on the hotel's marina - Italian/Mediterranean, highchairs available. Easiest possible first night, zero transit.

blocks.title: Diocletian's Palace
blocks.detail: Free entry, open 24/7 (some interior sites like the bell tower charge separately - skipping the steep bell-tower climb as a poor fit for younger kids). Peristyle, substructure halls, main sights at a family pace.

blocks.title: Lunch - Konoba Korta
blocks.detail: Inside Diocletian's Palace itself. Peka, pašticada, brodetto.

blocks.title: Dinner - Brasserie on 7, Split Riva
blocks.detail: Broad kid-friendly menu - burgers, pasta, ribeye. Easiest 'something for everyone' night.

blocks.title: Organized day-tour pickup at hotel
blocks.detail: Private/shared day tour with hotel pickup - handles Krka's parking and timed entry without a rental car, consistent with this family's preference for boat/organized transport over driving.

blocks.title: Krka National Park
blocks.detail: Skradin -> Skradinski Buk boat transfer included in the entrance ticket. IMPORTANT: swimming is banned at Skradinski Buk itself (since Jan 2021) - the swim stop is at Roški Slap, Stinice, or Pisak instead (all open for swimming Jun 1-Sep 30). Optional Skradinski Buk-Visovac-Roški Slap boat add-on ~€15-20/person.
blocks.notes: 2026 confirmed peak-season (Jun-Sep) pricing: €40/adult, €15/child (7-18), under-7 free -> ~€110/$120 for the family, plus the boat add-on (~€60-80/$65-85 for the family) if taken -> budgeting ~€160-190/$175 total. This is meaningfully higher than older published prices - confirm again closer to travel.

blocks.title: Lunch/snack near the park or on the return drive
blocks.detail: Packed lunch or a quick stop in Skradin town.

blocks.title: Drive back to Podstrana
blocks.detail: ~1h15m depending on traffic.

blocks.title: Dinner - Restoran Jure, Podstrana
blocks.detail: Waterfront, family-run since 1995, whole grilled fish. Close to the hotel after a long day.

blocks.title: Transfer to the boat departure point
Blue Lagoon boat trip + Trogir stop
blocks.detail: Shared speedboat tour - swim/snorkel time at Krknjaši Bay (the 'Blue Lagoon,' between Veli Drvenik and two islets), then free time in Trogir's UNESCO old town.
blocks.notes: ~$68-80/person for a ~4.5hr shared tour -> ~$280-320 for the family. Private charter (~€1,350 for up to 6) is an option if you'd rather not share the boat.

blocks.title: Lunch in Trogir old town
blocks.detail: Included as a stop within the tour window - casual waterfront spot in Trogir.

blocks.title: Rest / pool time, pack
blocks.detail: Last full day - real buffer before tomorrow's flight home.

blocks.title: Dinner - Konoba Matejuska, Split Old Town
blocks.detail: Tucked by the fishing harbor, black risotto - last-night dinner. Small space, book ahead.

blocks.title: Le Méridien Lav, Split - check out
Transfer to Split Airport
blocks.detail: ~27-40 min depending on traffic.

blocks.title: United - SPU -> EWR (1 stop) -> MIA
blocks.detail: SPU -> EWR with one connection, then a domestic MIA leg. Lands early morning the next day, July 31 (or same night depending on exact routing/timezone).
blocks.notes: Live seats.aero data for nearby June 2027 dates showed SPU/DBV -> EWR on United at ~44,000 miles/person, 1 stop. Budgeting ~50,000 miles/person (200,000 total) to cover the SPU-EWR international leg plus the EWR-MIA domestic connection. Exact July 30 2027 space isn't loaded yet - same booking-window constraint as the outbound flight.
blocks.flag: Not yet bookable - placeholder timing. Set a seats.aero alert for SPU-EWR/DBV-EWR in August 2026 when United's July 2027 space should open.

items.name: Book United MileagePlus outbound and return flights
items.note: Nonstop EWR-DBV and SPU/DBV-EWR space for July 2027 isn't loaded yet - set a seats.aero alert for August 2026 when the ~330-336 day booking window should open. Confirm the seasonal EWR-DBV nonstop is still operating for summer 2027.

items.note: Call the hotel/Marriott directly to find out whether 1 suite + rollaway can legally hold 2 adults + 2 kids, vs. the 2-room plan currently budgeted (270,000 points). Also check for any August points blackout pattern.

items.note: Suites are often cash-only or points+cash at Marriott properties - verify before counting on the 240,000-point estimate.

items.note: Only shoulder-season floor pricing ($140/night) was found - the $400/night estimate used here needs a live quote.

items.note: Wide pricing range across operators for both - get live quotes and lock in a specific operator once dates are confirmed.

items.name: Confirm sea kayak minimum age with Dubrovnik Sea Kayaking
items.note: Typically 7-8 for a paddling seat - check against the kids' actual ages at travel time.

items.note: All bookable closer to the date - exact 2027 pricing for kids wasn't as reliably sourced as adult pricing on a couple of these.
